name: Windows Enterprise multi-session
short_description: A Windows 10/11 Enterprise edition for Azure Virtual Desktop that lets multiple users hold interactive sessions on one virtual machine at the same time. Its use depends on eligible Windows Enterprise or Microsoft 365 licenses.
